chapter: Early listening, piano and adolescent conflict
title: Goodness of his upbringing in his music; humans as flowers of the earth
summary: Dance suggests his sunny sound comes from his father's teaching; Thompson agrees that people return to early teachings and calls humans the flowers of the earth.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: And perhaps it's the goodness of your background that came out in the expression of your feeling too perhaps, a background you may have been rebelling against in a way but which you respected and knew was good, whether it was good for you or not you did respect the goodness of it. And perhaps you know that sunny quality that comes out in your work, when you speak of happiness and joy and what not, perhaps some of that is derived from the background your father gave you. Could that be possible?
Well, I would like to think so. I mean, I don't normally like to get involved in theology, but in this type of interview, where what we're desiring to get

from me, you and I both, are the true facts of the way I feel, what's in me, what's going on within me. I would have to say that not only me but I think that everyone has a tendency to be brought back to the teachings that they had when they were children. If they've come up in a christian background I think they have to go back to the fundamentals of that christianity and their lives. Unless they are able to completely ignore them, like some people are, and I think that if they were brought up in another society I think that they would be brought back to their early teachings of that society.

But I've noticed in most fields of art, I think the nicer qualities are the most appreciated qualities by human beings, as we were discussing about human beings being flowers of the earth. I think that is very significant.
What was that you said exactly. When we were talking before you said that things that are created on earth, and you said that human beings are the flowers on the earth.
Yes, which is a very nice thought.

Yes, I believe that to be true in just in thinking quickly of the conversation that we're having, in that line. If you think, stop to think about it, it could be at least comparative that in flowers on the earth they are the most cherished of the plant growing life, as something of
beauty. People like to hold them, look at them, and they show colors of beauty and so forth.
Yes. I believe that the human race is the flower of the --
-- created animals, mammals of the earth.
I think that's what it expresses. That's why I believe that the beauty in music is the most appreciated -- appreciative.
